response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in full-stack development, cloud-native tooling, and AI-agent infrastructure (including MCP), aligning well with core requirements. However, his resume lacks explicit mentions of GenAI production systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM optimization—key technical areas for this role. His recent work in AI-agent tooling is promising but not fully aligned with enterprise GenAI delivery or customer-facing technical leadership in this niche.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience with TypeScript and Node.js, including AI-agent infrastructure (MCP) and developer tooling
Staff-level role at re:cinq demonstrating leadership in scalable systems and customer-facing technical work
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, direct mail automation at Optilyz)
concerns: No explicit evidence of GenAI production systems, vector databases, or RAG architectures in resume
Limited mention of cloud platform expertise (AWS/GCP/Azure) or multi-cloud experience
No clear demonstration of LLM performance metrics, optimization techniques, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI)
